assessment: No material errors, unsupported material claims, or important omissions found within the expressly selected standard base/core multiplayer scope.
scope: Kayenta Obsession second-edition base/core, 2–4 players, standard 16-round multiplayer, base objectives; marked expansions, optional modules/variants and other modes excluded.

sources_read.coverage: Relevant base setup pp.3, 6–12; complete core play/scoring pp.16–27; base detail pp.29–30, 35–43; complete FAQ pp.76–79; base gentry and scope labels pp.80–85; all improvement entries pp.86–104; VP cards p.105; all objective entries and Base labels pp.106–111; appended full Corrigendum 1.0.
Direct PDF inspection of p.12 standard round-track illustration; p.95 Lionheart text and tile faces; p.104 West Terrace text and tile faces; PDF structure checked for these pages.
Both pages read directly; p.2 Player Aid Note confirms full seasonal refresh.
Authorized supplemental reputation-objective evidence only: pp.7 and 14 via same-basename text and PDF p.14 objective illustration. No older gameplay or seasonal flow imported.

checked_claims.detail: The selected rules are Kayenta second-edition base/core, 2–4 players, standard 16 spaces: four courtships and twelve ordinary turns per player. Marked expansions and optional modes are excluded.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.6–7, 16; p.21 Hiring When Passing; pp.39, 43; appendix expansion/deck labels.

checked_claims.detail: Base components, family draft direction, 1.1 reputation, starting five servants/tiles, four family members, two starter guests with unused starters shuffled back, five objectives and all four family bonuses match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.3, 8–9, 35.

checked_claims.detail: For-hire counts, exclusion of butlers/housekeepers, money, monument selection and Estate-monument restriction match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium p.10, steps 1–5.

checked_claims.claim: Bag, opening market and Alderley Hall setup
checked_claims.detail: All nonstarter base tiles including activity-to-monument suites are included; opening eligibility, duplicate stacks, orientation, sorting and first theme match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.11–12; p.78 Setup FAQ. PDF p.12 standard-track illustration inspected.

checked_claims.detail: Service rotation moves each servant once; round events precede ongoing effects; exact attendees and complete service are required; favours precede purchases; used servants, gentry and tile cleanup match. Passing refreshes service/gentry before event/effects and benefit.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.17–21, 30.

checked_claims.detail: Village Fairs 3/9, objectives 6, Builders’ Holiday 11, National Holiday 14, courtships 4/8/12/16 and their effects match. No ordinary courtship turn or ongoing income.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.12 standard-track illustration, 16–17, 76 Courtship FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: One icon is one increment; five increments per level; limits 1.1 and Max.5; special-action costs, affordability, repetitions and excess-reputation handling match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.26–27, 77 Reputation FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: Screening level is fixed at end of step 2; later expenditures may lower actual reputation without invalidating the activity. PR does not restrict acquisition/scoring, and National Holiday waives PR only.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.18, 26, 77 Reputation FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: Money is public and supply unlimited; no interplayer transfers in scope; positives precede negatives; money penalties must be funded, including mandatory borrowing if necessary and possible.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.19, 26, 36, 76–77 Favours FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: Housekeeper/Brushing Room substitutions require no available maid/valet respectively; underbutler can substitute for base male servants even when available; unique servants cannot be recruited. Butler’s Room hiring/recruitment and destinations match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.29–30, 88.

checked_claims.detail: Only Butler’s Pantry acquires the underbutler, immediately to Expended Service; ordinary two-rotation availability and stated earlier-refresh options follow the rotation and service rules. Servants’ Quarters tile allows one quarters servant each turn.
Unlimited hand/discard, kept-guest disclosure, rejected-guest bottom decking without disclosure, optional dismissal from hand/activity/discard and family immunity match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.19, 35–36, 76 Favours FAQ.

checked_claims.detail: Family favours/VP, Young Lady male-prestige condition, Charles/Elizabeth service and favours, 8 VP and the two base gossip effects match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.80, 83–85; pp.22–24 for Fairchild return/scoring.

checked_claims.detail: Normal upgrades are mandatory on use; ongoing tiles cannot host; hybrid orientation, alternating category and face-up category scoring match. South Lawn Estate requirement is five gentry including two family.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.20, 39, 93 Green Room, 101 South Lawn.

checked_claims.detail: Barn triggers Estate activities; Servants’ Hall consumes one available servant and shifts one reputation subject to minimum protection; base monuments begin paying on later ordinary turns. Private Study and Village Fair interaction match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.17, 27, 39, 86 Barn, 95 Lionheart, 99 Private Study/Queen’s Suite, 101 Servants’ Hall.

checked_claims.detail: Heritage doubles all favours including negatives; Queen’s doubles one chosen favour; Lionheart draws its guest, waives personal service, doubles nonnegative favours, retains the guest and upgrades into a monument. All suites have an unmodifiable one-guest count.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.79, 93, 95, 99; Lionheart PDF p.95 text and tile illustration inspected.

checked_claims.detail: Library objective/VP-card sides and family counts match. Base West Terrace remains an activity with butler and three family on both sides; its upgraded favour adds optional one-to-four dismissal. Alternate ongoing West Terrace is excluded.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.96, 104; PDF p.104 text and both base tile faces inspected.

checked_claims.detail: Other base activity names and instruction to follow printed current-side service, counts, favours, prices and VP are consistent; Long Gallery decreases four attendees to two. No required base exception was found missing.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.86–104, all unmarked base entries; p.95 Long Gallery.

checked_claims.detail: Normally one Market/Reserve tile total per turn; price modifiers, £300 Reserve base, £100 floor and universal duplicate prohibition match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.20, 40.

checked_claims.detail: Market refill sliding/sorting/duplicate stacks, public unrestricted Reserve selection, Service then PR1 Reserve timing, Largest Wine Cellar exception, and refresh exclusion of set-aside tiles match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.40–41, 79 Tiles FAQ, 95 Largest Wine Cellar.

checked_claims.detail: All three seasonal refreshes occur after Reserve movement, before new theme, anticlockwise first-player pass and marker advance. The older Seasonal Flowchart omission is expressly corrected.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium p.23 End of Season and Designer’s Note; Corrigendum 1.0 p.2 Player Aid Note, read directly from PDF.

checked_claims.detail: Builders’ Holiday and Market Purchase permit multiple purchases from one unchanged market, all before refilling; the summary correctly applies the shared no-between-purchases-refresh rule. Multiple VP refreshes and separate passing/special refresh allowances are supported.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.40, 42, 78 Special Actions FAQ, 105 Market Purchase/Market Refresh.

checked_claims.detail: Base five-plus-two objectives with four discards leave three; extra objectives increase retained count; discarded objectives/used VP cards return to deck bottoms. VP benefits, choice against final VP, own-turn use, immediate draw use and final opportunity match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.22–24, 42, 77 Objectives FAQ, 79 VP Cards FAQ, 96, 105.

checked_claims.detail: Fairchild return, current-theme scoring including negatives, ordinary tie rewards, final four-theme scoring, final reputation-level tiebreak, final discard and final benefit opportunity match. Game ties use Fairchild then reputation level then shared victory.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.22–24.

checked_claims.detail: All face-up tile VP, hand/discard gentry, remaining fulfilled objectives, reputation 1/3/6/10/15/21/28, two VP per servant, floor wealth/£200 and unused VP cards match.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.24–25.

checked_claims.detail: The ten group values/requirements, two guest bonuses, five category bonuses, basic-common-servant bonus, five servant-set bonuses, four individual-tile bonuses, monument and wealth bonuses match the Base-labelled entries. Tiles need not be upgraded; face-up hybrids govern category.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium pp.42, 77, 106–111. Base-labelled entries only; replacements/expansion-only entries excluded.

checked_claims.detail: The summary’s 7-VP requirement of maximum level, represented by Max (standard level 7), is supported by the authorized French base source. This is distinct from compendium p.27’s Max.5 storage limit and does not import older seasonal rules.
checked_claims.source_refs: Compendium p.111 Reputation Bonus; Super Meeple official localized base rules pp.7 and 14, text read and p.14 objective-card illustration inspected.

independence_statement: Fresh independent source audit. I read only the assigned summary snapshot, the permitted authoritative extracted rules/PDFs and the permitted supplemental French source (including its same-basename text). I did not read questions, keys, reader answers, grades, prior audits, or any other QA files; did not communicate with readers; did not edit the summary or author repairs. Findings were derived by independently comparing the complete relevant base rules and base-labelled appendices with the snapshot, without presuming a pass.
